sources.snippet: About Longitudinal brain-MRI disease-evolution platform. Tracks how tumour findings change across serial studies: 3D SegResNet segmentation (0.92 Dice whole tumour, held-out BraTS), registration, cross-time lesion matching, change detection with propagated uncertainty, evidence-linked 3D timeline. Every answer traces to a measurement. Research prototype.

sources.snippet: Brain tumor segmentation on BraTS-2023 dataset using nnUNet, SegResNet, and SwinUNETR. Models trained and evaluated on MRI scans to segment tumor sub-regions: WT, TC, ET, and RC, with fold-wise performance visualizations.
